name: context
description: Generate verified project evidence with a semantic frontier and deterministic structural ranking. Use --no-embeddings when exact code identifiers are already known.

outputSchema.jumpTargets: array - ranked file, symbol, line range, confidence, relevance, reasons, and optional snippet
outputSchema.byFile: object - jump targets grouped by file
outputSchema.metadata: object - retrieval strategy, semantic candidate count, module coverage, token counts, roles, and timing
outputSchema.embeddingSync: object - skipped, checked, updated, or degraded embedding state
outputSchema.evidence: array - compact symbol and location references
outputSchema.nextActions: object - suggested checks requiring agent judgment
outputSchema.answerDraft: string - deterministic routing metadata, not a final answer

formats.returns: Jump targets without the code snippets section
Jump targets, snippets, evidence, and next actions

notes: Use --embeddings for conceptual or cross-system questions whose implementation vocabulary is unknown
Use --no-embeddings for concrete function, class, route, configuration, or path identifiers
Convert semantic chunk symbols into one deterministic follow-up query
Refine conceptual queries by one behavior boundary or missing evidence role, not unrelated symbol lists
Read returned file ranges and candidate test setup/assertions before making coverage claims
Trace API behavior through registration, authorization, persistence, public consumption, and failure tests
Challenge the leading subsystem with one competing module or negative check
Treat missing targets, truncation, and budget exhaustion as unresolved evidence gaps rather than confirmed absence
Stop when every required evidence role has a grounded location and added results provide no novelty
